title: Create the Wikibase instance
detail: Decide host (wikibase.cloud or self-hosted) and the item/property prefix; the paper draft shows chublets.wikibase.cloud as illustrative only.

title: Create the property-metadata properties
detail: The four rows with origin 'new' and phase 0 in wikibase-property-set.csv: equivalent Wikidata property, equivalent CodeMeta term, equivalent schema.org term, close match Wikidata property. Everything created afterwards can document itself.

title: Create ALL properties of the set in one go
detail: Every row of wikibase-property-set.csv: crosswalked, codemeta-only, wikidata-only and chublets-addition. `phase` says when a property is first populated, not whether it exists. Keep a table Wikidata PID -> local PID.

title: Fill the property metadata
detail: For every property: equivalent Wikidata property (the twin PID), equivalent CodeMeta term, close match Wikidata property for CodeMeta-only rows, formatter URL for external-ids, constraints copied from Wikidata where useful (P1324 requires P8423).

title: Create the class items
detail: chublet (local twin of Q141115627), Little Minion, research software, software library, application software, script file; link each to its Wikidata twin.

title: Create the controlled-vocabulary items
detail: Git, the programming languages and host applications from vocabulary.json (currently all unresolved), the 56 open-archaeo tags after reconciliation, version types, licences.

title: Create person and organisation items
detail: Developers: reconcile through GitHub username (P2037) first, name string second. Q66606154 and Q88865971 already exist in Wikidata.

title: Import the example chublets
detail: Start with the examples in examples/ and check them in the UI before any batch.

title: Batch-import open-archaeo (phase 1)
detail: Use the 208+208 split from n4o-rse/open-archaeo; QuickStatements syntax with local property IDs.

title: Populate phases 2 and 3
detail: Phase 2 from repository metadata (CFF, CodeMeta, GitHub API); phase 3 properties exist but are filled manually or by later sources.

title: Export check
detail: Run the SPARQL queries in sparql/ against the new instance and compare with the CodeMeta projection.
